title: New Party Lawmakers Walk Out as Erdoğan Opens Parliament Year
detail: Lawmakers of Özgür Özel's New Party walked out on Oct 1 as Erdoğan opened the new legislative year, protesting İmamoğlu's jailing and the court-imposed CHP leadership change. Özel: "We have no time to spend listening to someone who jailed our presidential candidate." Erdoğan appealed for consensus and proposed drafting a new constitution.

media.caption: New Party lawmakers walk out of parliament

title: Özel Urges Erdoğan to Resign or Call Election Over Investment Fund Crisis
detail: Following the Sept 17 liquidation order, 455,758 investors across 131 funds run by seven portfolio managers (Tera, Pusula, Atlas, Hedef, A1 Capital, Bulls, Pardus) hold about $18.3B in frozen assets. Özel said Erdoğan must either resign or call an immediate election. Erdoğan said the matter is being resolved quickly; interim payments of up to 1M lira per investor per fund are planned. An AKP co-founder warned on Oct 2 the scandal could cost the party elections.
